A '''golden axe''' is the [[Golden equipment|golden]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], crafted from [[Gold Ingot|gold ingots]]. It mines at speed 12 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/golden_axe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/gold/axe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines axe blocks at speed 12.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Fortune]] I
* {{MCW|Looting}} I

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Golden equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Gold Ingot|gold ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Gold Ingot|gold ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/gold_ingot_from_blasting_gold_materials.json}}</ref>
